title: Constraints Liberate, Liberties Constrain — Runar Bjarnason
summary: Runar Bjarnason's Scala World talk argues that restraint and precision in components beat power and flexibility. Constraints on parts make them easier to compose into systems.
why: HN recommends it as a talk that changes how you think about system design, and links it whenever constraints, abstraction or least power come up.

quote.text: It had a real impact on the way I think about the design of systems.
